characters.body: Inside a chronicle you always play that chronicle’s character. Sheets lock after creation; ask for changes through downtime.
characters.emptyBody: Join or create a chronicle, then forge a character for it.

bring.title: Bring {{name}} into a chronicle
bring.body: Only your chronicles with the same rules as this sheet are listed. Once in, the character stays in that chronicle.
bring.none: None of your chronicles uses the same rules as this character. Join one first, or ask its Storyteller to add you.
bring.failed: Could not bring the character into the chronicle.
bring.offer: Or bring a character that has no chronicle yet:

error.edition: This character uses different rules than that chronicle.
error.line: This character is from a different game line than that chronicle.
error.locked: You already have a locked character in another chronicle. Only a site administrator can allow more.
error.already: This character already belongs to a chronicle.

create.title: New character
create.step1: Join or create the chronicle first; the wizard asks which chronicle the character belongs to.
create.step2: Have a concept, background, description, ties and gear ready; the Storyteller hooks plots into them.
create.step3: Follow the Storyteller’s limits on starting dots and powers.
create.step4: The sheet locks when you finish. Later changes go through a downtime request.

tz.title: Time zone
tz.label: Display time zone
tz.hint: Message times, dice history and admin timestamps use this zone.

ooc.title: Out-of-character portrait
ooc.body: Shown when you speak as yourself (out of character). In story rooms others see your character’s portrait.

downtime.sent: Request sent to the Storyteller and staff.
downtime.body: Sheets are locked after creation. Ask the Storyteller or staff to change stats, merits or story flags; they approve or reject with a reason.

password.title: Change password
password.body: After the change you stay signed in on this device; every other device and browser is signed out and needs the new password.
password.changedBody: You stay signed in here; every other device has been signed out.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.body: Lost a device or signed in on a shared computer? Sign out everywhere ends every session of your account, this one included.
